fact: Revenue Services Lesotho's online form registers individual taxpayers (employees, directors, partners) and asks for a TIN (New) in the format 200000000-0.

Revenue Services Lesotho says individual taxpayers can register online through eTax to obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number, while companies obtain the TIN from RSL after registering with the relevant ministries.
Revenue Service Lesotho said every client can register online through its fully implemented e-Taxation system.
